name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 6px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion` support. Larger rings help motor-impaired users see where they are on mobile and touch devices, while 4.5:1 meets WCAG for text and simple graphics. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it’s necessary for touch accuracy and clarity.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 6px at 4.5:1 still risks users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—some screen reader users toggle reduced motion *and* use high-contrast themes. Alternative: 4px ring at 7:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` override. Settle with user testing: measure task completion for motor-impaired users on touch devices with both settings enabled.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` override. High-contrast rings solve the dual need of motor-impaired users on touch devices and screen-reader users who keep reduced motion off for clarity. The trade-off is a thinner ring, but 4px remains visible on most touch targets and meets WCAG 2.2 AA for non-text contrast. User testing will confirm if this balances visibility and reduced motion without extra visual weight.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 still fails users who toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high-contrast themes—7:1 is for normal contrast, not high-contrast modes. Alternative: 5px ring at 7:1 with `forced-colors: active` override. Settle with user testing: measure task completion for screen-reader users in high-contrast mode.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 5px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion` and `forced-colors: active` overrides. Result: EXCAVA focus ring meets all contrast and reduced-motion needs. Owner: accessibility-w1.
